0022600122.text: Miami enters at 0-2, having lost both of its games at home, and sits fifth in the Southeast, 2 games back, and 15th in the East. Dallas is 1-1 on a one-game win streak, sitting third in the Southwest and 9th in the West, and is missing Caleb Martin (thumb), Cooper Flagg (shoulder), Dereck Lively II (foot), Santi Aldama (knee), and Tarik Biberovic (heel), while Kyrie Irving is day-to-day with rest. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with Dallas winning the last meeting 118-108 in Dallas on December 3, 2025.
